tidbit: Did you know… a story marked Still open means nobody on the record has confirmed it yet.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Grok has unveiled a seven-minute artificial intelligence-generated short film called Odyssey, marking a significant milestone in long-form cinematic creation. Reported by KuCoin: Grok's Odyssey episode challenges traditional filmmaking approaches.
Grok released the first episode of The Odyssey series, a seven-minute segment that draws comparisons to Nolan's three-hour theatrical film. Reported by SSBCrack: this release showcases a different vision for the Odyssey story.
OpenAI has unveiled a new GPT-6.1 Terra model that reportedly surpasses GPT-6.1 Sol in code review performance. Still open, per 36Kr: whether this challenges OpenAI's existing model hierarchy.
Anthropic faces a seven hundred fifty billion dollar compute bill that could delay the company's path to profitability. Reported by The Globe and Mail: this substantial investment shapes Anthropic's financial trajectory.
Kin Insurance has opened its quoting system to ChatGPT agents, enabling instant quotes through WebMCP technology. Reported by Insurance Business: artificial intelligence agents can now shop for home insurance directly.
Free every hour.
